claim: spec/proposals/2026-08-31-task-lifecycle.md ('Component renames (delete+create, names are identity)') frames BeadReader -> TaskReader as a single paired rename, but bead generation split that pairing into two independent beads with no ordering between them: spexmachina-swvx.7 (BeadReader cleanup, this bead) and spexmachina-swvx.14 (TaskReader construction). spexmachina-swvx.7 was handed out as 'next ready in epic' while spexmachina-swvx.14 is still status:open.
authoritative_source: The prior implementation cycle recorded the intended order directly in code: plan/bead_reader.go's header TODO reads 'Remove this file and its callers once spexmachina-swvx.14 lands TaskReader and cmd/spex/plan.go's --beads flag retires'; cmd/spex/plan.go's --beads flag carries the mirroring TODO(bead:spexmachina-swvx.14) noting '--beads stays wired until then'; and plan/doc.go's package comment states the --beads/BeadReader input 'is still ReadBeads/ReadBeadsBytes behind --beads pending spexmachina-swvx.14 (TaskReader) and spexmachina-swvx.7 (BeadReader cleanup)'. All three agree TaskReader (swvx.14) landing is the precondition for BeadReader's removal (swvx.7), which the bead dependency graph does not encode.
evidence: cmd/spex/plan.go:107 calls plan.ReadBeadsBytes (BeadReader) as the only mechanism populating beadStatus for NodeMatcher's pairings. spec/plan/module.json's PlanCommand component (92ae9dab6d6d) instead requires --tasks and TaskReader (80afb22dab75, arch_task_reader.md) as of the current spec, but TaskReader has no implementation (bead spexmachina-swvx.14 is open; no plan/task_reader.go exists) and cmd/spex/plan.go has no --tasks flag at all yet. Deleting plan/bead_reader.go and its callers now, as this bead's cleanup instructions direct, would remove PlanCommand's only task-state input path with nothing to replace it -- breaking `go build ./...` and leaving `spex plan` unable to read task state. `br show spexmachina-swvx.7 --json` lists dependencies on spexmachina-f6eh.21 (closed, BeadReader's original construction bead) and the parent epic only -- no dependency edge on spexmachina-swvx.14.
proposed_fix: Add a blocks dependency from spexmachina-swvx.7 onto spexmachina-swvx.14 in the bead graph so the BeadReader cleanup bead cannot be claimed until TaskReader lands and cmd/spex/plan.go's --beads flag retires to --tasks. Once swvx.14 ships, re-open this cleanup bead; at that point plan/bead_reader.go, plan/bead_reader_test.go, the Bead type, and every --beads reference in cmd/spex/plan.go become safely deletable in one pass.
